reasons: plain subprocess in a new session; no filesystem, network or credential boundary

gates.G1: established on the release host for one provider and fifteen synthetic repository-repair tasks in five families (evidence/live, evidence/wp11, evidence/wp12); advantage gate (AT17) executed under three frozen protocols and not passed
gates.G2: established on the release host for the three fixture task families: repository repair, source-grounded document amendment and numerical transformation run through one owner/scheduler/policy build with registered domain observers and independent oracles (AT23, evidence/wp10/at23); memory and analytical adapters per AT14-AT16 and AT25 (tests); the native PSE graph engine integrated as a contained analytical worker with independent references and separate measurements (ADR-18, evidence/pse); advantage gate (AT17) executed on the document and numerical families under protocol 5 (evidence/wp14) and not passed; the associative memory layer (ADR-20) executed under protocol 6b (evidence/wp15): the engine's walk over verified co-citations carried the required source in every needed run including the held-out family (10/10 against 0/10 for the provenance view) and cost two of six unneeded runs (the declared harm bound of one was exceeded); under protocol 7 (ADR-21) carried sources say in the prompt why they are there, which kept every needed outcome, brought the unneeded family to the provenance view's level against the unlabeled control, and made the associative view the document pack's default as declared
gates.G3: established in the blueprint's scoped sense (ADR-22, evidence/wp15): on the association distribution, with the document pack's declared progress channels, a readout trained on 48 retained decisions of the system's own runs met the declared held-out criterion on two unseen topics (equal verified success, 2836 against 5425 mean tokens, no false completion), its held-out decision loss was 0.045 against the rule's 6.91, and the memory's promotion rule admitted it; it ships pinned as the document pack's default routing policy with its provenance; it learned one legible fact (stop when the unmet claim's expected source was not retrieved), can only stop a repair earlier than the rule, and stopped one recoverable repair on a seen task; protocol 4 on the hard tier (evidence/wp13) had trained no readout and rejected the episodic ablation

known_issues: a catalog, registry or reducer change needs an explicit migration (gabriel migrate: backup, equivalence replay, recorded epoch); journals created before catalog records existed migrate only when the running code reproduces them

the native PSE executables are built from source per host (cargo); without them native graph operations are refused at proposal time, and without python-flint window certificates are unknown (never success)

the native engine's arithmetic is platform-independent by construction (pure-Rust libm, ADR-19) but was executed on this platform only; the engine's crystal and consensus paths remain quarantined and the state readout is a specified model quantity, not a measurement
advantage over a simple verification loop not shown; the evaluation corpus is saturated for gpt-4.1-mini

the associative view (ADR-20, the document pack's default since ADR-21) carries sources that verified runs cited together into a budgeted prompt whether or not the task needs them; the prompt says why each is there, which under protocol 7 kept gpt-4.1-mini from stating the forbidden figure (6/6 first attempts without the reason, 0/6 with it) but cost two repairs on one needed task; one provider, one presentation; the lexical seeds are tie-broken by observation id

the document pack's default routing policy is a readout promoted on one constructed distribution with one provider (ADR-22); it can only stop a repair earlier than the rule, it abstains where its declared channels are missing, and it stopped one recoverable repair on a seen task; a task that pins rule-based-v1 explicitly opts out

license.note: The root license governs the original software and manuscript materials; bundled external datasets keep their own attribution and terms (data/ATTRIBUTION.md), and a subdirectory license covers only its subtree.

supported_backends.linux_namespace: supported containment backend; requires Linux user namespaces, util-linux unshare and setpriv; verified by gabriel doctor --selftest on the release host
supported_backends.trusted_local: explicitly separate trusted mode without containment; opt-in only
